system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: system prompt 改为只注入 top-K 匹配项
system_prompt_style.note: Skill matching injects skill info into system prompt; Light path injects none. Editable System Prompt also shipped.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Light 路径不注入任何 Skill 信息，节省 context window
env_context_strategy.note: Phone environment, not a repo; skills are injected into prompt, no filesystem/repo context. Closest value; mismatch noted.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: 内置模型切换、System Prompt 编辑、缓存清理和历史裁剪
context_compaction.note: 历史裁剪 = history trimming; see also Agent/Engine/ConversationMemoryPolicy.swift

observation_format.evidence_quote: 接收 JSON 参数，返回 JSON 结果
observation_format.note: Tool results are JSON-ish rendered as text; camera/photo images fed to the VLM (MiniCPM-V).

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: 模型先 emit `<tool_call>` 调用真实 iOS API

tool_count.note: Tools/ToolRegistry.swift not included in evidence; exact count of exposed tools unknown (health skill alone has 9).

edit_primitive.note: File operations listed as unchecked/planned; no file-editing tool ships.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: 每项能力对应一个 Markdown 文件（SKILL.md），新增或修改能力不需要重新编译 App
tool_schema_source.note: SKILL.md frontmatter + Swift-registered tools in Tools/ToolRegistry.swift.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: 再去 `Tools/ToolRegistry.swift` + `Tools/Handlers/<Name>.swift` 注册对应工具
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A mention anywhere in README or file tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: 保留 processInput 的 5 路分流（VLM / Planner / Preflight / Agent / Light）
loop_primitives.note: Agent path is tool-call loop (maxRounds=10); Planner path is Selection → Planning; routing itself is a fixed dispatch.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: 保留 Selection → Planning 两步 LLM 调用
planning_granularity.note: Planner emits validated JSON plan (validateSkillSelection); only on capable models (supportsStructuredPlanning).

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: 更强的规划模型或多模型协作链路
multi_agent_topology.note: Multi-model collaboration listed as unchecked future work.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: 更强的规划模型或多模型协作链路

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: 对不明确的时间、标题、联系人和删除/批量操作会先问清楚再执行，避免误删或创建错误内容
human_in_loop.note: Clarification/confirmation before destructive ops; plus iOS system permission prompts and Mac pairing approval (在 Mac 端审批配对).

short_term_state.evidence_quote: 新增历史会话记录，支持新会话、切换会话和删除会话
short_term_state.note: ChatSessionStore keeps message history; planner plan is transient.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: 在 `Skills/Library/<skill-id>/` 下增加一个 `SKILL.md`，或者运行时写到应用沙盒
long_term_memory.note: Skill library of Markdown files persists across runs; user-added skills written to app sandbox.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: 新增历史会话记录，支持新会话、切换会话和删除会话
state_persistence.note: Sessions persist and can be reopened; no explicit mid-run resume code cited.

self_verification.evidence_quote: 框架会在启动时自动校验 `allowed-tools` 与 `ToolRegistry` 是否同步
self_verification.note: Only startup schema validation and validateSkillSelection on plan JSON; no tests/linters/judge over agent output.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Selection 有独立的 `validateSkillSelection()` 验证，失败可以便宜重试
retry_policy.note: Only step-level validation retry, not whole-task retry.

rollback.note: No undo/rollback mechanism described; side effects go to iOS system stores.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: 现有终止逻辑（无 tool_call + maxRounds=10 + validation failure + shouldSkipToolFollowUp）已足够健壮
termination_condition.note: model_declared = absence of tool_call ends chain; maxRounds=10 is the step cap.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: 推理预算改为按实际可用内存动态计算
cost_controls.note: Inference/token budget from memory; 5-way routing and local vs Mac remote model selection. Prefix caching explicitly rejected (ADR-007) though cross-turn KV reuse was later added.

timeouts.evidence_quote: 端侧每次 LLM 调用延迟 3-8 秒
timeouts.note: No per-tool or per-run timeouts documented in the evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: 在 iPhone 上完成推理和 Skill 调用，可用自然语言处理日历、提醒事项、通讯录、剪贴板、健康数据等本机任务
execution_isolation.note: Skills run in-process as Swift functions inside the iOS app sandbox.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: 或者运行时写到应用沙盒
filesystem_access.note: iOS app sandbox plus permission-gated system stores; no general filesystem tool.

network_policy.evidence_quote: 只有用户明确使用联网搜索、读取网页或配对 Mac 远程推理时才离开 iPhone
network_policy.note: Network reachable only through the `network`-type skills (web-search/URL read) and LAN gateway; otherwise offline.

permission_model.evidence_quote:
allowed-tools:
- my-tool-name # device 类必填; content 类可留空数组 []
permission_model.note: Each skill declares an allowed-tools list validated against ToolRegistry; plus iOS OS-level permission grants.

tracing.evidence_quote: 写错的 tool 名会立刻在控制台暴露
tracing.note: Live/Debug/LiveMetrics.swift exists; no structured trajectory export documented.

replayability.evidence_quote: 写错的 tool 名会立刻在控制台暴露
replayability.note: No replay facility mentioned in README or file tree.

eval_hooks.note: Benchmark harness exists for planning-model experiments, not an agent-task benchmark runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: 框架会在启动时自动校验 `allowed-tools` 与 `ToolRegistry` 是否同步
guardrails.note: Also Agent/Engine/GuardedSkillRouter.swift in file tree; destructive ops require clarification first.

target_domain.evidence_quote: PhoneClaw turns phones into local AI agent runtimes with on-device models, native mobile Skills, LiveLand, and optional Mac Gateway inference.
target_domain.note: Closest fit: on-device mobile assistant driving iOS system APIs (calendar/contacts/health), plus web search/URL reading. Not an SWE harness; mismatch noted.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: 让 iPhone 端可以配对并使用 Mac 上的 Ollama、Codex CLI 或 Antigravity CLI 作为远程推理源
